text: Every tribe has someone who mends. Here that is you: a kettle over the fire, a rattle in your hand, and the old rites.
- The [Spirit Kettle](spirit_kettle) brews **remedies** from a reagent, a herb and a base.
- [Remedies](remedies) come as tinctures to drink, salves to lay on, and incense to burn for everyone at once.
- The [Healer's Rattle](healers_rattle) mends whoever you look at, for a little Pulse.
- [Spirit Sickness](spirit_sickness) is what the March's worst spirits leave on you, and why all of this matters.
- The [Healing Circle](healing_circle) heals a whole camp and calls fallen familiars back.
- A [sweat lodge](sweat_lodge) sends you to bed hurt and wakes you whole.

pages.title: Where to start
text: Build the kettle first. Set it on a lit campfire, stand a Resonance Totem nearby and keep the lattice fed. A stack of salves in your pack is the difference between a hard night in the March and a walk home.
